The world of payment processing is rapidly evolving, and businesses are looking for loyal and strategic partners, to help them grow.
Meet Nuvei, Nuvei is the global fintech building the infrastructure for every payment, everywhere. Its modular, flexible, and scalable technology enables leading companies to accept next-generation payments, offer all payout options, and benefit from card issuing, banking, risk, and fraud management services. Connecting businesses to their customers in more than 200 markets, with local acquiring in 52 markets, 150 currencies, and over 720 alternative payment methods, Nuvei provides the technology and insights for customers and partners to succeed locally and globally through one integration.
At Nuvei, we live our core values, and we thrive on solving complex problems. We're dedicated to continually improving our product and providing relentless customer service. We are always looking for exceptional talent to join us on the journey!
 Your Mission
 We are looking for a Senior Power BI Analyst to join our fast-growing Business Automation & Analytics team. You will be responsible for designing, developing, and governing advanced Power BI solutions built on our modern data platform (Microsoft Fabric and Databricks). Your key focus will be delivering high-quality, data-driven insights to operational teams and senior management.
In this role, you will act as a subject matter expert in business intelligence, ensuring that reporting solutions are accurate, scalable, and aligned with organizational standards. You will collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders and data engineering teams to translate business requirements into robust analytical solutions, from the lakehouse layer through to the final report. You will also promote best practices in data modeling, visualization, and governance. The position requires a high level of professionalism, strong analytical capabilities, and the ability to communicate insights effectively to both technical and non-technical audiences.
 Key Responsibilities
Lead the design, development, and ongoing maintenance of enterprise-level Power BI dashboards and reports
Partner with business stakeholders, senior management, and C-level executives to define KPIs, metrics, and reporting requirements
Report insights, trends, and solution recommendations directly to C-level and senior leadership to support strategic decision-making
Translate complex business needs into scalable data models, advanced DAX calculations, and user-friendly visualizations
Build and maintain Power BI semantic models on Microsoft Fabric, using Lakehouse, Warehouse, and Direct Lake connectivity
Develop and maintain data preparation pipelines in Fabric (Dataflows Gen2, Data Factory pipelines, notebooks) to support reporting needs
Work with curated (gold-layer) data in Databricks, writing SQL and PySpark to shape analytics-ready datasets and connecting them to Power BI
Collaborate with data engineering on lakehouse design (medallion architecture, Delta tables) so reporting models are efficient and reliable
Ensure data accuracy, consistency, governance, and ongoing data hygiene across all reporting and analytical assets
Drive data hygiene initiatives, including identifying data quality gaps, standardizing definitions, and improving source system reliability
Optimize performance of datasets, reports, and data refresh processes in alignment with best practices, including Fabric capacity usage and Databricks SQL query performance
Establish and enforce Power BI and Fabric workspace standards, methodologies, and governance frameworks, including deployment pipelines, version control, and access management
Provide technical leadership and mentorship to junior team members
Deliver analytical insights and recommendations to support strategic and operational decision-making
 Requirements
6+ years of experience in Business Intelligence or Data Analytics, with significant hands-on experience in Power BI
Advanced proficiency in DAX, data modeling, and Power Query
Strong experience with SQL, data warehousing, and ETL processes
Hands-on experience with Microsoft Fabric (Lakehouse, Warehouse, Dataflows Gen2, OneLake, Direct Lake semantic models)
Working experience with Databricks (Databricks SQL, Delta Lake, notebooks) and connecting Databricks data to Power BI
Good knowledge of Python/PySpark for data transformation
Understanding of lakehouse and medallion architecture concepts
Demonstrated ability to work with senior stakeholders and deliver business-focused analytical solutions
Deep understanding of business
Strong communication skills in English (reading and speaking required)
 Nice to Have
Microsoft certifications such as PL-300 (Power BI Data Analyst) or DP-600 (Fabric Analytics Engineer), or a Databricks certification
Experience with Unity Catalog or Microsoft Purview for data governance
Experience with CI/CD for BI assets (Fabric deployment pipelines, Git integration, Azure DevOps)
Experience working with Salesforce data in a reporting context
 Benefits
 The benefits will be discussed with the TA Partner.

So, please come as you are. We can't wait to meet you.
